1940, February & October
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
ST. BONAVENTURE'S MONASTERY 1740 Mt. Elliott Avenue Detroit, Mich. Feb. 21, 1940
Mrs. Eleanor Stumm Traverse City, Mich.
Dear Mrs. Stumm :-
God bless you and yours. Hope you are all well. Pleased indeed to know of the progress and good out-look of your "Novena- movement." .... Ray Garland was in this evening, in fact just left befor time to close up. He has been having trouble with a bruised shinsince Xmas time. It is almost healed now ..... Mine too is quite improved. He brought me some of the special salve the head Dr. at Ford's made up for him.
I want to try it To-night ..... hope its good. How is Bob and the employment coming along .... and the two girls .. . Neighbors.etc.
God bless all and each Fr. Solanus O.M.Cap.
ST. BONAVENTURE'S MONASTERY 1740 Mt. Elliott Avenue Detroit, Mich. October 25th, 1940
Mrs. Eleanor Stumm Traverse City, Michigan
Dear Mrs. Stumm :-
God bless you and yours. Only just now I read your note of October 11th ... Why of course it would be alright to hold your St. Anthony devotions or novenas any convenient time. Perhaps Thurs- day for a try-out. Perhaps Fr. Verreau was kidding you .---- It is real spiritualism that's wanting to him as well as to you and myself and every one of us. Spiritism of course would be some- thing else. I think you'll find a difference in Webster .... Any- how have patience and be sure. "The darkest hour is often the hour before day. Keep up courage and God's blessing to yourself and all our friends in Traverse City - Fr. Solanus
Original in possession of: Mrs. Stumm 301 Maryland Grand Rapids, Mich.
